newsitem.title: POLAND: BOS AGREES TO RESTRUCTURE SWARZEDZ DEBT.
newsitem.headline: BOS AGREES TO RESTRUCTURE SWARZEDZ DEBT.

text.p: Polish Bank Ochrony Srodowiska (BOS) agreed to change short-term debts of the ailing furniture maker Swarzedz SA into medium-term liabilities, Swarzedz's spokesman said on Thursday.
"We will change the short-term libilities to medium-term ones," Sebastian Szczesny said.
According to the agreement Swarzedz will pay back the loans in three years time. Szczesny declined to reveal the extent of the debts.
In November last year Swarzedz signed a similar deal with the Polish Development Bank (PBR) .
The company had a net loss of 33.7 million zlotys on 96.9-million-zloty sales in 1996 January-November period.
Szczesny also said Swarzedz expected a council of all the firm's creditors to decide on a general debt restructuring plan for Swarzedz in the next few weeks, but did not give details.

He said the individual agreements with PBR and BOS could change if the general debt restructuring plan worked out by the council of all creditors, including PBR and BOS, was in contradiction with the deals.
Among Swarzedz's other main creditors are Bank Gdanski and Powszechny Bank Gospodarczy SA (PBG).
